what.text: Asylum seekers from India reside in host countries including the United States, Canada, Italy, Australia, and South Korea.
In 2025, the United States hosted 98011 asylum seekers from India.
Across all host countries combined, there were 181121 asylum seekers from India at the end of 2025.

why.text: The Armed conflict over Kashmir territory, India was active from 1995 to 2025 and involved Kashmir insurgents.
The Armed conflict over the government of India was active from 1996 to 2025, involving PWG, MCC, CPI-ML-J, and CPI-Maoist.
The Interstate armed conflict between India and Pakistan was active during 1996 to 2003, 2013 to 2020, and in 2025, involving the Government of Pakistan.

when.text: The year-end count of asylum seekers from India in all host countries combined stood at 9786 in 2000.
The total grew over the following years, reaching a peak of 202933 asylum seekers in 2024.
Main displacement years for the origin were recorded from 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources do not provide information on displacement routes or living conditions.
Instead, figures report asylum seekers from India as year-end totals in all host countries combined.
